subject: Online ordering portal completely unavailable at Chromepet location since 10:45 AM
description: The ServeWell online ordering portal (customer-facing web and mobile app) has been completely inaccessible since approximately 10:45 AM IST on 15-Dec-2025. Customers attempting to place orders through the portal receive a generic HTTP 503 Service Unavailable error message. All in-store POS systems remain operational, but we are unable to process online orders placed through our website or mobile application. The receipt printer (asset PRN-0066-P1, Epson TM-T88VI v1.12) is functioning correctly for in-store transactions. This outage is directly impacting revenue during peak lunch hours and causing customer dissatisfaction, with approximately 25-30 pending online orders stuck in the system queue. I have confirmed that our store's internet connectivity is stable (tested via direct ping to 8.8.8.8 with 100% success rate), and all other networked systems are responding normally. The issue appears to be centralized at the portal backend level rather than at the store infrastructure level.

ticket_history.note: Ticket received and logged. Initial verification performed: confirmed portal unavailability across multiple access points (web and mobile). Store connectivity verified as stable. Escalating to L2 backend systems team for urgent investigation.

Customer follow-up call completed with store manager to gather additional context on order volume impact. Informed that approximately 25-30 online orders are queued and waiting. No ETA provided yet from L2 team.
